span.title: EHDSObservation means a structured set of data elements describing a clinical finding or measurement and its results. This includes simple observational findings (e.g., alcohol and tobacco use, blood pressure measurements) and complex medical test results (e.g., cardiopulmonary stress test, Holter monitor), supporting the grouping of related observations and the representation of multi-part results observed under shared or different conditions.
